item.title: Login Shinai Aida ni Netorareru Heroine-tachi...
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: FreespaceP
  • 発売日: 2017-12-25
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ログインしない間に寝取られるヒロイン達…
  • 英語名: Login Shinai Aida ni Netorareru Heroine-tachi…

あらすじ

“Independent Nation: St. Arect Women’s Academy’s War Chronicle”

is a student raising MMO simulation game in full-diving style.

Players become a teacher in the academy, whose obligation is to protect

female students from vicious-minded guys who try to invade the academy.

Students are all programmed with artificial intelligence, which means

they chat, think and take behaviors just like humans in this game.
